instruction: Set Chrome's default font size to Very Large.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled Do Not Track in Chrome by navigating Settings > Privacy and Security > Third-party cookies, toggling the DNT option, and confirming the dialog. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome menu, navigate to Settings, find specific settings sections, toggle switches, and confirm dialog prompts.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the same Chrome settings navigation capability but in a different section (Appearance) with a different control type (dropdown/selector instead of toggle).
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome Appearance settings and changing default font size to Very Large (24px). Evaluator uses official chrome_font_size getter and check_font_size metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter chrome_font_size correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and returns dict with default_font_size key, which is the exact state needed to verify the instruction.
Metric check_font_size correctly accesses result['default_font_size'] and compares it against rule['value'] (24) using exact match, which is appropriate for this discrete setting.
Expected value 24 correctly maps to Chrome's 'Very Large' font size setting.
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure Preferences file is flushed to disk before the getter reads it.
Single-step instruction with single verification point - complete coverage achieved.
